projects.title: SmellGo.hu
projects.description:
The website lets customers turn their own photos into premium, personalized car air fresheners. From seamless photo uploads to custom scent selection, the experience is designed to feel effortless and playful.

You might recognize the brand from 'Shark Tank Hungary'.

projects.title: Viverte.com
projects.description:
Users can collaborate with expert designers to create bespoke pieces, using high-quality materials tailored to their preferences.

The project integrates a sleek, user-friendly design interface, allowing customers to preview and adjust their designs before finalizing.

projects.title: PemDelian.com
projects.description:
Pem Delian is a premium skincare and cosmetics brand built for multi-market EU sales.

The webshop supports multiple languages and currencies, and features extensive custom development — from tailored frontend components and a product quiz (Routine Finder) to dynamic upsell and gift logic.

External fulfillment providers are seamlessly integrated, enabling scalable international logistics while preserving a high-end, conversion-driven customer experience.

You may also recognize the products from dm stores in Hungary and Germany.

projects.title: Misty-Monday.com
projects.description:
Misty Monday was created to make everyday scent rituals feel more distinctive.

The webshop supports multiple languages, currencies, and Shopify Markets, with custom frontend components, dynamic upsell logic, gift flows, and external fulfillment integrations.

The project focuses on clear brand storytelling, polished product presentation, and a minimal shopping flow that keeps the fragrance world easy to understand and easy to explore.

The products may also feel familiar from dm stores in Hungary.

projects.title: taatipastry.hu
projects.description:
TAÁTI Pastry Studio is a Budapest-based boutique pastry brand where desserts are presented as shared rituals.

Alongside the D2C storefront, a separate B2B site was built with custom B2B ordering logic for wholesale and partner ordering workflows.

Customers can place orders with pre-selectable date and time slots in the cart for pickup or delivery.

Visit taatipastry.hu and try the experience.

projects.title: Celeni.hu
projects.description:
Celeni is a Budapest-born fashion line built around precise tailoring and timeless, effortlessly sophisticated silhouettes.

Today, it spans far beyond clothing and accessories into a full lifestyle brand: Celeni Design offers interior styling, brand, and social content services, while Camp Anima is a seasonal wellness retreat — pilates, restorative yoga, and shared meals in nature.

projects.title: VitezKurtos.hu
projects.description:
Vitéz Kürtős has been baking kürtőskalács — Hungary's "hungarikum" chimney cake — since 2000, from a family recipe from Székelyudvarhely, Transylvania.

The webshop ties together four locations: two inside Budapest Zoo, a showroom in Budapest, and a shop in Tihany on Lake Balaton. Alongside them runs the Vitéz Gastro line — Hargita beechwood charcoal and the brand's own Bake'n'Roll grill, shipped across the EU.

Custom ordering logic handles location-aware delivery and pickup, seasonal flavors, gift vouchers, workshop bookings, and a loyalty program.

projects.title: Anibox.hu
projects.description:
Every gift at Anibox is unique, because you can personalize it yourself.

Planning a wedding, an anniversary, Christmas or a baby shower? Want to surprise someone in your family? A name, a date, a photo or a few words of your own make the occasion unforgettable.
